title: Probability, Curvature and Spectrum on Graphs
summary: We show that, for a metric graph equipped with the Laplacian operator $Δ=-\frac{d^2}{dx^2}$, the graph trace formula admits a new interpretation in terms of quantum probability and curvature. Our approach is based on a notion of graph curvature inspired by Wilson-lines and holonomy, together with von-Neumann's ergodic theorem.
